note: The stock IEEE-39 no-event run is NOT stationary (0.62 pu start-up jump). Cause: upstream never applies pfd.xfmr_k (6-31, k = 0.9714, to-bus side); with only that tap applied the jump is 2.2e-4 pu and the 10 s drift is at the level of the stock power-flow residual (1.8e-3 pu). The tool itself is deterministic, serializes and resumes. This is an upstream case/code defect, not an installation failure; the TX4 adapter applies the documented taps.
